objective: Close the bounded-autonomy Floor Governance Cell roadmap with durable Council sessions, verified derived-memory context, and a fail-closed typed admission seam for future fine-tuned Ascalon inference without changing authority ownership.

rulesConsidered: Floor Guardian remains highest authority inside a floor.
Ascalon remains bounded cognition and may not become sovereign authority.
F07 remains the final production verification/release boundary.
The existing F00-F07 topology is unchanged.
The mandatory .okf decision protocol remains the architectural gate.

forensicFindings: GuardianKernel already provides a floor-local autonomy loop and GuardianPolicy already enforces cross-floor, critical, repeated-failure and irreversible-action boundaries.
The existing healer substrate has resource locks, deduplication and rollback but did not have a per-resource fencing epoch in ResourceLock contracts.
HealerEngine currently executes an allocated squad sequentially; the new JointHealingSession is therefore a foundation rather than a production scheduler replacement.
CaseManager retains a legacy direct resolveCase() escape hatch; the new ResolutionGate defines the target closure proof but is not yet wired into every legacy caller.
Advisor is currently represented mostly by concepts/UI/docs; this wave introduces CounselPacket but does not claim a production Advisor runtime.
No complete production BDA boundary is wired into every live floor handoff; this wave provides the boundary subsystem foundation.
changes: Added durable FloorCouncilSessionStore with per-floor hash-chained persistence and restart escalation.
Added proposal fingerprinting and explicit Council phase checkpoints.
Reused existing MemoryFabric as bounded derived Advisor context; Council persists only memory references.
Added AscalonInferenceAdmissionGate with SHADOW and ADMITTED modes, context binding, confidence checks and explicit model allowlisting.
Wired admitted Ascalon proposals into the existing Council rather than directly into execution.
Added governance/admission telemetry to the MemoryFabric high-signal event set.
Added final-wave regression tests for restart recovery, memory provenance, shadow/admitted inference, direct-execution denial and allowlist fail-closed behavior.
Updated .okf final-wave decision, audit and canonical architecture records.

security.notes: Final-wave runtime remains typed control-plane code. Ascalon ADMITTED mode fails closed when ASCALON_ALLOWED_MODEL_REFS is absent or the model is not allowlisted. No secrets or credentials were added.

verificationPlan: Run the dedicated Floor Governance Cell Final Wave workflow.
Run Team Change Gate plus the repository CI and affected governance/cognitive regression workflows.
Review final-wave negative tests and runtime boundary evidence.
Update this report to PASS only after the final executable head is green.
Keep fine-tuned Ascalon deployment outside the claim until a separately validated inference gateway is connected.
dispositionRationale: Final-wave implementation is on the PR branch, but dedicated final-wave CI and required repository/security evidence are not yet green; no merge or production promotion is claimed.
